import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def main():
    line = sys.stdin.readline()
    n = int(line.strip())
    
    if n == 0:
        print(0)
        return
    if n == 1:
        print(2)
        return
    if n == 2:
        print(3)
        return
    
    dp_b = [0] * (n + 2)
    dp_r = [0] * (n + 2)
    
    dp_b[1] = 1
    dp_r[1] = 1
    dp_b[2] = 1
    dp_r[2] = 2
    
    for i in range(3, n + 1):
        dp_b[i] = (dp_b[i - 1] + dp_r[i - 1]) % MOD
        dp_r[i] = dp_b[i - 1] % MOD
    
    ans = (dp_b[n] + dp_r[n]) % MOD
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
